review_note: Reviewed 5.0→5.7 delta; adopted build-artefact Read-denies. Deliberately NOT adopted (Supabase-variant divergence): pino route-logging enforcement (pino removed as unused; API logs via console.error), lefthook (uses husky/lint-staged), better-auth/Drizzle add-skills, tc CI/harness-verifier layer (has bespoke CI + no .harness-base). migrate Phase-5 re-sync N/A: no .harness-base merge base (seeded pre-5.3). 2026-07-10: cherry-picked the 5.8 hard comment gate (no-inline-comments error + sonarjs/no-commented-code) independent of a full 5.7→5.9 re-review; templatecentral_version left at 5.7.0 since the rest of that delta hasn't been audited. 2026-07-14: ran templatecentral:add (documentation) for 5.10's per-folder README governance — adoWiki defaulted false (GitHub-only repo, no Azure DevOps signal). 2026-07-16: drift-check against plugin 5.11.0 (project pinned 5.7.0) — reviewed the full 5.8-5.11 changelog; almost all of it is lefthook/CI-action-pinning/NestJS/FastAPI/OpenCode-adapter churn that doesn't apply to qkit's bespoke-CI, husky, Supabase-only setup. Two things did: (1) this project's per-folder READMEs already write real per-file content, not a filename-only manifest, matching 5.11's richReadme opt-in — recorded as richReadme:true. (2) readme-freshness here is a local pre-commit nudge only (scripts/check-readme-freshness.mjs, never blocks); 5.10 additionally seeds a CI job that hard-fails a PR with an unstaged README — deliberately not adopted, no CI-blocking doc gate exists yet. templatecentral_version left at 5.7.0 — most of the 5.8-5.11 delta is inapplicable, not yet fully re-audited. 2026-07-24: lefthook migration — the project owner overrode the 2026-06-05/07-16 husky decision to bring qkit's git-hook architecture in line with loopkit/stockkit/paykit/merqo. Replaced husky+lint-staged with lefthook (`lefthook.yml`, `.lefthook/`), replaced scripts/check-readme-freshness.mjs with .lefthook/readme-coupling.sh (same non-blocking nudge, now a lefthook pre-commit command), and split .claude/settings.json's inline `node -e` one-liner hooks into standalone .claude/hooks/*.sh|.cjs script files (loopkit's reference implementation). Net-new: .gitleaks.toml, .claude/verify-harness.sh (integrity sensor, wired into lefthook pre-push and left for CI to adopt later), .claude/regen-harness.sh (human-run-only baseline rewrite), and a SubagentStop hook (qkit had none before). templatecentral_version bumped 5.7.0 → 5.11.0: the 5.8-5.11 feature deltas (comment gate, README governance/richReadme, unused-vars gate) were already substantively reviewed in the entries above, so this bump reflects that this migration closes the one remaining architectural gap — the git-hook layer itself — rather than a fresh, unreviewed version jump. This also folds in the security hardening loopkit's hook scripts carry that qkit's old inline one-liners lacked: the LEFTHOOK=0/LEFTHOOK_EXCLUDE/core.hooksPath= bypass block, protected-branch/force-push/guard-file-checkout guards, a broadened --no-verify regex, an .env* catchall deny (previously only the specific .env.<env> variants), and OWASP LLM02 credential-leak detection in the prompt guard. seeded_files below now covers the full lefthook + hook-script-file set; `.claude/hooks/verify.sh` (the pre-existing manual build+check+test gate) is unchanged and kept.
